45445e7b66:
In the last battle, we lost despite having mobile armors
of every number and kind... But we gained something too.
People! The strength of a pilot's will to win!
0262f17875:
Your Excellency Dozle, I have a report.
As ordered, I have scouted out
some excellent mobile armor pilots.
aaac64fb0b:
Now, everyone.
Pay your respects to Vice Admiral Dozle.
fe1322c10e: Ordering me around? Are you my superior officer?
f5245f0ab6:
..........
...B-big brother?
It's you, big brother! I missed you!
96e9716f37:
Brother... I have no memories of family, of anything...
...I want to know more about myself!
I hate being alone!
1b144159df:
Alone... Death? Is someone going to die!?
No, I don't want death!
No, nooooooo!
ff03afc449:
Y-yes. Their personalities are a little troubled,
but once you put them in a mobile armor,
their ability is guaranteed.
09d1539e77:
I don't like the way you put that...
Very well. If Glemy says so,
they must be usable.
df71a29daa:
And it's not only them.
We have also succeeded in obtaining the Dark Gundam.
fdb0718388:
Someone called Master Asia was scheming behind it, I recall.
You say you obtained its data?
a1fc056c79:
Yes, but there is one problem. A pilot absorbed
as the Dark Gundam's biological unit seems
to lose control of their own will.
a63d014900:
I don't care! I'll pilot the Dark Gundam myself!
Guts will take care of something like that!
Wahahahaha!
afb4f44710:
Third time's the charm...? Dozle schemes to invade
Earth. Resolved to turn even his own body into a weapon,
he has no weak spots. The truly final battle begins now!
516d5128cc:
I lose even with this...?
Are you saying my guts weren't enough!?
Then next time for sure!!
b421a81782:
I came to bring you home, of course, Father.
No matter how many times you try, you can't conquer Earth!
Why don't you understand that?
7db93d622c:
Don't talk nonsense!
I'm a soldier. A soldier who builds the Zabi tradition!
What kind of soldier can't take an Earth or two!?
1dd83bb1bc:
That's what's wrong in the first place!
Earth and the colonies don't matter.
The two must coexist and understand each other...
8af3343c75:
We are capable of that.
By clinging to Earth, Father, you are trying to
nip mankind's potential in the bud!
f72e9ff1e5:
No buts!
Let's go back to Side 3, Father.
There's someone I want you to meet.
ced6fa059b:
What? Someone you want me to meet!?
I-I won't allow it, Mineva!
You're still too young!
